terms.label: incremental parsing
terms.definition: Reuse already parsed text or structure when a stream or edit changes only part of the document.

terms.label: abstract syntax tree
terms.definition: A hierarchical representation of parsed Markdown, code or another document, with nodes for its meaningful parts.

terms.label: stable prefix
terms.definition: The earlier part of an evolving input that is unchanged and can safely be retained.

terms.label: guarded fast path
terms.definition: A cheaper specialized operation that runs only when its assumptions are satisfied.

terms.label: full-parse fallback
terms.definition: Rebuild the entire syntax tree when incremental reuse is unsafe.

terms.label: scroll anchoring
terms.definition: Keep a visible item in the same apparent place when items above it grow, shrink or are inserted.

terms.label: scroll virtualization
terms.definition: Render only nearby items in a long scrolling list while retaining a model of offscreen sizes.

terms.label: momentum scrolling
terms.definition: Continued scrolling after a finger is lifted, driven by native inertial motion.

terms.label: elastic overscroll
terms.definition: The temporary rubber-band displacement beyond a scrollable area's normal bounds.

terms.label: hydration
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state
terms.definition: Restore previously saved application state into a newly initialized interface; the stored state may arrive after user interaction.

terms.label: write epoch
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state
terms.definition: A version of write authority used to reject operations from an earlier account, session or state lifecycle.

terms.label: read barrier
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state
terms.definition: Wait for outstanding reads or establish their outcome before deciding whether a write or deletion is appropriate.

terms.label: optimistic update
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state
terms.definition: Show an intended change immediately before the server acknowledges it.

terms.label: selective rollback
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state
terms.definition: Undo only the parts of a failed change that have not since been replaced by newer edits.

terms.label: field-level versioning
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state
terms.definition: Track versions separately for independent settings instead of assigning one version to the entire record.

terms.label: provisional identity
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state
terms.definition: An identifier remembered or discovered before an authoritative listing confirms it exists.

terms.label: generation counter
terms.definition: A monotonically changing identity used to discard asynchronous results from an obsolete lifecycle.

terms.label: eventual consistency
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state
terms.definition: Different replicas or views may temporarily disagree and later converge; not proof of a particular product's consistency guarantee.

terms.label: Web Worker
terms.definition: Run JavaScript outside the browser's main UI thread and communicate by messages.

terms.label: CompressionStream
terms.definition: Browser API for native streaming compression, such as gzip, without a separate JavaScript codec.

terms.label: transferable object
terms.definition: An object whose underlying resource ownership can move between message endpoints instead of being cloned.

terms.label: Long Animation Frame
terms.definition: Browser performance entry for a long rendering frame, including script and rendering timing information when available.

terms.label: Interaction to Next Paint
terms.definition: Responsiveness metric covering interaction delay through the next presented paint.

terms.label: long task
terms.definition: A lengthy main-thread task that can prevent input and rendering from progressing.

terms.label: microphone preconnection
terms.definition: Prepare or validate audio capture before establishing a voice connection; exact implementation remains to be inspected.

terms.label: audio clock mismatch
terms.definition: Capture, playback or expected delivery clocks disagree, potentially causing accumulated timing error.

terms.label: playback underrun
terms.definition: Audio playback needs another block of samples before the producer supplies it, causing a gap or stutter.

terms.label: cross-tab coordination
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state

terms.label: structured clone
terms.definition: The browser's general object-copying mechanism for messages and storage, distinct from transferring ownership.

terms.label: request correlation
terms.definition: Associate a returned result or failure with the request that produced it.

terms.label: read timeout
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state

terms.label: conditional write
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state

terms.label: mutation sequence
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state

terms.label: AST grafting
terms.definition: Attach newly parsed nodes to an existing syntax tree rather than recreating stable nodes.

terms.label: source offset adjustment
terms.definition: Translate local character positions in a reparsed fragment back to positions in the complete document.

terms.label: deferred scroll adjustment
terms.definition: Accumulate corrections to scroll position while a finger gesture or native scrolling is active, then apply them after settling.

terms.label: touch-end grace period
terms.definition: A short interval after touch release in which scrolling may still be owned by the browser.

terms.label: measurement invalidation
terms.definition: Mark cached item sizes or positions stale after a layout change.

terms.label: draft ownership
terms.definition: Associate unsent text with the intended conversation and account, so another tab or identity cannot overwrite it accidentally.

terms.label: hydration timeout
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state
terms.definition: A bounded wait for persisted state to become available, rather than treating a slow read as an empty draft.

terms.label: write suppression
terms.definition: Temporarily prevent writes when ownership or account state is uncertain.

terms.label: storage retry guard
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state
terms.definition: Check that a failed save is still current before trying it again.

terms.label: query cache reconciliation
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state
terms.definition: Merge a fresh server response with local pending changes without erasing them.

terms.label: mutation rollback ownership
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state
terms.definition: Determine whether a failed asynchronous write still owns a particular field when its failure arrives.

terms.label: pending optimistic patch
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state

terms.label: provisional session listing
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state

terms.label: confirmed absence
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state
terms.definition: Evidence that an object is deleted or inaccessible, rather than merely not yet returned by a pending request.

terms.label: bounded recovery
terms.category: Conversation drafts, settings and session state

terms.label: capability handshake
terms.definition: Announce supported operations before a peer attempts to use them.

terms.label: gzip
terms.definition: Lossless compression format for reducing a response payload or file before transport or storage.

terms.label: frame scheduling delay
terms.definition: Waiting for a rendering opportunity even after the event handler or other main-thread work has finished.

terms.label: script attribution
terms.definition: Identify which code or invoker contributed to a measured delay.

terms.label: conversation tree
terms.definition: A possible representation of message ancestry and alternate branches, useful when editing an earlier prompt or regenerating a reply.

terms.label: selected leaf
terms.definition: The currently selected endpoint of a branch through a conversation; a candidate representation to verify in the client.

terms.label: stream cancellation
terms.definition: Stop an in-progress delivery or consumer when the user cancels or its owning request becomes obsolete.

terms.label: connection recovery
terms.definition: Reconnect after the internet or transport disconnects; determine separately whether an interrupted reply resumes, restarts or fails.

terms.label: stream decoding
terms.definition: Incrementally turn incoming response bytes into events or text as a reply arrives.

terms.label: request deduplication
terms.definition: Avoid submitting the same request twice when a connection is interrupted or work is retried.

terms.label: WebRTC session rollover
terms.definition: Replacement or renewal of a WebRTC session; investigate when and why a voice connection changes identity.

terms.label: media silence detection
terms.definition: Notice an interval without expected media activity, distinct from loss of transport signaling.

terms.label: socket silence detection
terms.definition: Detect lack of expected messages on a signaling or network connection.

terms.label: audio buffering
terms.definition: Hold samples between capture, processing or playback to absorb differences in timing.

terms.label: attachment admission
terms.definition: Decide whether a selected file can enter a processing or upload flow given its properties and policy.

terms.label: document conversion
terms.definition: Transform an uploaded file into a representation suitable for extraction, preview or model input.

terms.label: per-call consent
terms.definition: Ask the user for permission before an individual tool action is performed, rather than granting unrestricted standing authorization.

terms.label: tool permission
terms.definition: A boundary on which actions a tool can perform without asking for additional approval.

terms.label: tool lifecycle
terms.definition: Track a request for a tool, any approval, execution, result and its association with the conversation.

terms.label: interactive artifact
terms.definition: A generated object or interface that can be displayed and interacted with separately from ordinary message text.

terms.label: incognito draft
terms.definition: Unsent content associated with a private conversation whose persistence boundaries require separate verification.

terms.label: account isolation
terms.definition: Keep account- or organization-owned state distinct when identities change; client hints do not establish the full security guarantee.

terms.label: usage limit
terms.definition: A boundary on allowed usage over a defined period or entitlement.

terms.label: spend limit
terms.definition: A cap on additional spending, distinct from a model's usage quota.

terms.label: model entitlement
terms.definition: The set of model capabilities available to an account under its plan or usage policy.
